exchangeRate.conversion: Foreign currency amount / foreign-currency units per EUR * CNY per EUR; rounded to nearest CNY. ECB rates are reference rates, not transaction quotes.

chinaMarketSearch.result: Searches targeting decathlon.com.cn did not return a matching official China product page with a verifiable price. Follow-up searches found JD self-operated listing leads for All Road 900 and SNB 100, but the public category/search pages did not expose current CNY amounts and the item pages were blocked by JD risk control. These are domestic-market leads, not verified price quotes or proof of brand-authorized seller status.
chinaMarketSearch.officialChinaSearch: Web search queries restricted to decathlon.com.cn and exact model names; no exact official China product page with a current price was returned.

domesticRetailerLeads.observedEvidence: JD search/category results label entries as Decathlon ALL ROAD 900, identify ID 4263567 as 166 cm, show self-operated (自营) and 32+ reviews. A separate 4263566 result includes a malformed size string and was not mapped to a size.
domesticRetailerLeads.limitations: The result page did not expose a current CNY price; product detail navigation was blocked by JD risk control. Self-operated status does not by itself establish Decathlon brand authorization.

domesticRetailerLeads.observedEvidence: JD search results label the item Decathlon SNB 100, grey, 156 cm, ID 4278169; 96 reviews were displayed at capture.
domesticRetailerLeads.limitations: The result page did not expose a current CNY price; the 156 cm listing is a domestic sales lead only and was not used to set price or season for the seed.

unmatchedCandidatesExcluded.exclusionReason: Search results do not identify Park & Ride 500, an exact model season, or manufacturer article number; not mapped to that seed.
